description: Blind grader verdicts for one document against one reference checklist (test C).

items.description: One entry per checklist item, in checklist order.

id.description: The checklist item id, exactly as given.

evidence.description: Verbatim quote from the document for found or wrong; empty string for missing.

fabrications.description: Specific claims the document makes that neither the checklist nor its own cited evidence supports.
